description: Work with your CaptivateIQ commissions: add and update employees, keep data worksheet records such as deals in step, update quotas, list plans, period groups and payout dates, and export payout summaries.

captivateiq_employee_updated_trigger.description: Runs when an employee in CaptivateIQ is added or changed, such as made inactive or given a final process date. Each change starts it once; changes made before it was turned on don't. CaptivateIQ is checked at most every 5 minutes.

output.employee_id: Your organization's own ID for the employee
output.final_process_date: Last date payouts are processed for them (YYYY-MM-DD)
output.is_active: Whether the employee is active (takes a seat)
output.linked_user: The ID of the user they sign in as

captivateiq_job_finished_trigger.description: Runs when a CaptivateIQ job, such as an export or an import, finishes, with its status and an export's download link. Jobs finished before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.details: Errors, or the download_url of a finished export
output.download_url: The export's download link, empty if there is none
output.metadata: Who started the job and when
output.status: PENDING, RECEIVED, STARTED, SUCCESS, FAILURE, REVOKED, REJECTED, RETRY or IGNORED
output.url: The job's address in the API

parameters.description: Which finished jobs start it: any (the default), success or failure.
parameters.name: outcome

captivateiq_new_employee_trigger.description: Runs when an employee is added to CaptivateIQ, with their employee ID, name, email and status. Employees already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. CaptivateIQ is checked at most every 5 minutes.

output.employee_id: Your organization's own ID for the employee
output.final_process_date: Last date payouts are processed for them (YYYY-MM-DD)
output.is_active: Whether the employee is active (takes a seat)
output.linked_user: The ID of the user they sign in as

captivateiq_new_user_trigger.description: Runs when someone is given a CaptivateIQ user, with their email, role and whether they're an admin. Users already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.is_organization_admin: Whether they are an organization admin
output.linked_employee: The ID of their employee record
output.login_id: Login ID, for organizations that sign in without email

captivateiq_new_worksheet_record_trigger.description: Runs when a record, such as a deal, is added to a CaptivateIQ data worksheet, with its values by column name. Records already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.data: The record's values, by column name
output.worksheet_id: The ID of the data worksheet the record is in

parameters.description: The data worksheet to watch.
parameters.name: worksheet_id

captivateiq_payouts_processed_trigger.description: Runs when payouts are processed for a new payout date, for every plan or one you choose. Hand the date to 'Export payout summaries' to get each payee's payout. Dates already processed when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.plan: The ID of the plan watched, empty when watching every plan

parameters.description: Only payouts for this plan. Leave blank for every plan.
parameters.name: plan

captivateiq_worksheet_record_updated_tri.description: Runs when a record in a CaptivateIQ data worksheet is added or changed, with its values by column name. Each change starts it once; changes made before it was turned on don't.

output.data: The record's values, by column name
output.worksheet_id: The ID of the data worksheet the record is in

parameters.description: The data worksheet to watch.
parameters.name: worksheet_id
